$comment: PSI's inputs to the platform permissions generator (SEB authz/tools/gen/estate.py says what each key means). Estate mode: platform_dir is the installed bundle's authz/, whose core and autorizare modules psi never copies; psi's fga.mod lists only psi's modules. Generated artefacts live under estate/authz/. Run from psi's root: AUTHZ_ESTATE_ROOT=$PWD python3 .seb-bundle/authz/tools/generate.py --estate estate/authz.json
